name: Xin Yao
bio:
After years leading architecture work at scale at Capgemini and Danske Bank, I now offer strategic consulting to help companies expand the full potential of their software - and the people behind it.

I work at the intersection of Domain-Driven Design (DDD), product strategy, sociotechnical architecture, organizational development, and change leadership.

I help organizations navigate the twin challenges of shifting complex systems and evolving human dynamics.
